model_name.notes: Discrete-time stochastic population model with childhood pool and sexual debut

version.notes: Added pre-sexual childhood pool, sexual debut mechanism, probabilistic orientation/activity assignment

model_notes.calibration_status: In Progress. [DONE: IntPop (1970 Weights), AgeBins, Mortality ('15-'19 Avg), Fert('15-'19), TFR Mulitplier, SexDebut Set)
model_notes.intended_use: Thesis research on HIV prevention interventions
model_notes.academic_framing: A discrete-time stochastic population model for HIV transmission dynamics and prevention interventions, developed from scratch for the Netherlands context with modern computational best practices.
v4_features: Pre-sexual childhood pool (children aged 0-14 outside transmission system)
Sexual debut mechanism at configurable age (default 15)
Probabilistic MSM orientation assignment at debut (not birth)
Probabilistic sexual activity assignment at debut (not birth)
Childhood mortality separate from adult mortality
Cohort turnover with delayed entry into risk
Optional fertility tables (ASFR), life tables, population adjustments
model_notes.population_flow: Birth -> Childhood pool (age 0-14, sex only) -> Sexual debut (age 15) -> Orientation + Activity assignment -> HIV transmission system

step_size.notes: Number of units per timestep (12 months = 1 year timestep)

n_runs.notes: Number of stochastic simulation runs (use 100+ for uncertainty analysis)

seed.notes: Base random number generator seed for reproducibility

deterministic_mode.notes: If true, replace random draws with expected values (for debugging/testing)

enabled.notes: Master switch for writing output files

write_per_run_files.notes: If true, write one file per run; else aggregate only

terminal_summary.notes: Print summary to terminal at end of simulation

write_state_counts.notes: Write detailed state counts (can be very large files)

summary_years.notes: Which years to include in terminal summary

quantiles.notes: Quantiles for aggregated outputs (median and 90% interval)

initialization_method.notes: Relative age–sex weights based on 1970 population structure

enabled.notes: If false, no demographic changes except aging and mortality

mode.notes: 'closed' (no births), 'fixed_net_addition' (constant entrants into childhood), or 'fertility_table' (use ASFR)

enabled.notes: Pre-sexual childhood pool. Children age through 0-4, 5-9, 10-14 before sexual debut.

age_bins.notes: Childhood age groups (5-year bins from birth to sexual debut age). NOT part of the HIV transmission system.

background_mortality_annual.notes: Annual background mortality rate for children (used if life_table not enabled for childhood ages)

initial_per_bin.notes: Initial childhood population per 5-year bin. 'auto' computes from adult population size and sex ratio. Or provide {"male": N, "female": N} per bin.

debut_age.notes: (Documentation ONLY - not used by code, hard-coded to first age bin)

p_msm.notes: Proportion of males assigned MSM at debut

use_population_activity_distribution.notes: Uses same distribution as population (recommended) for debuts. Use README for custom. Will cause drift otherwise.

enabled.notes: If true, override background mortality with life-table survival probabilities

survival_by_age_limit.notes: Piecewise survival probabilities up to each age_limit (probability of surviving from birth to that age). Annual survival probabilities. Bin Rate --> [(lxB/100,000)/(lxA/100,000)]^0.2. Ref Excel

source_notes.notes: Human Mortality Database (HMD), Netherlands, period life tables 2015–2019, protocol v6

enabled.notes: Enable births via age-specific fertility rates (ASFR)

asfr_by_age_limit.notes: Births per woman-year, piecewise by age band (age-specific fertility rates). ASSUMPTION--After 50, 0% Source: Human Fertility Collection (fertilitydata.org) Netherlands ASFR (standardized) https://www.fertilitydata.org/Country/Country?code=NLD

enabled.notes: If true, apply year-specific multipliers to baseline ASFR. Source: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb/figures/detail/86244ENG

values.notes: Fertility multipliers by calendar year (interpolated between years). Age Bins 1 and 9 Excluded. Check Excel REFS. https://www.macrotrends.net/global-metrics/countries/nld/netherlands/birth-rate

migration.notes: V9 Patch: Net Migration Module. Demographic stabiliser only — entrants are Susceptible/Undiagnosed/No-ART/No-PrEP. Toggle enabled:true to activate.

enabled.notes: Master switch. Safe default: disabled. Set true to activate net migration.

quantity.notes: How much net migration to apply each year. Exactly one mode is active.

year_specific.notes: World Bank Netherlands net migration data 1970-2020. Missing years default to 0. Source: https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SM.POP.NETM?locations=NL

rate.notes: Annual net migration as fraction of current total population. Only used when mode='rate'. E.g. 0.003 = 0.3%/yr.

flat.notes: Constant annual net migration (persons/year). Only used when mode='flat'. NL historical average ~44,000/yr.

profile.notes: How entrant migrants are distributed across age-sex bins.

mode.notes: Active profile mode: 'mirror' | 'working_age' | 'custom'. Default 'mirror' is safest.

working_age.notes: Parameters for working_age profile. Only used when profile.mode='working_age'.

max_age.notes: Oldest age (inclusive, at bin boundary) for working-age migrants.

custom_weights.notes: Per-bin age-sex weights for custom profile. Auto-normalised. Only used when profile.mode='custom'. Example below covers adult prime-fertility ages only.

aging_method.notes: Method for aging population through age bins. Options: 'fractional' (20% annual transfer, smooth mortality) or 'discrete' (100% transfer every 5 years, legacy method). Recommended: 'fractional' for realistic mortality curves.

background_mortality.notes: Annual non-HIV death rate for sexually active population (used if life_table not enabled)

annual_entrants.notes: Number of births per year (enter childhood pool at age 0-4, only used if mode='fixed_net_addition')

enabled.notes: If true, apply exogenous multipliers to population totals over time (for calibration).

value.name: MSM
value.notes: Men who have sex with men

orientations.notes: Sexual orientation groups - assigned at sexual debut, NOT at birth

age_groups.notes: Sexually active age groups in 5-year bins. Children (0-14) are in the separate childhood pool.

sexual_activity_groups.notes: Sexual activity levels. contact_rate = acts per year (combined with per-act beta for transmission). Assigned at sexual debut, NOT at birth.

hiv_stages.notes: HIV disease stages - DO NOT MODIFY ORDER

orientation_contact_multipliers.notes: Multipliers applied to base contact rates by orientation. Female ~30% fewer contacts, MSM ~150% more contacts than heterosexual males. Defaults to 1.0 if not specified.

heterosexual.notes: Mixing matrix for heterosexual contacts (Female to Heterosexual_Male). Rows must sum to 1.0.

msm.notes: Mixing matrix for MSM contacts. Rows must sum to 1.0.

condom_usage.notes: Condom risk multiplier by activity group. Applied as: effective_beta = beta * condom_mod. Values: 1.0 = no condom effect (baseline), 0.5 = 50% risk reduction. Lower = more protection.

beta_acute.notes: Per-act transmission probability during acute infection

beta_chronic.notes: Per-act transmission probability during chronic infection

beta_aids.notes: Per-act transmission probability during AIDS stage

acute_to_chronic.notes: Annual probability of progressing from acute to chronic HIV

chronic_to_aids.notes: Annual probability of progressing from chronic to AIDS (untreated / not on ART)

chronic_to_aids_on_art.notes: Annual probability of progressing from chronic to AIDS while on ART. Literature: ~0.5-1%/yr with viral suppression (Mocroft et al. 2010, CASCADE collaboration). ~10x reduction vs untreated. Used for cost-effectiveness and QALY calculations.

acute.notes: Annual HIV mortality during acute stage

chronic.notes: Annual HIV mortality during chronic stage

aids.notes: Annual HIV mortality during AIDS stage

combine_with_background.notes: 'excess' (HIV mortality added to background) or 'override' (HIV mortality replaces background)

annual_rate.notes: Annual probability of HIV diagnosis (if undiagnosed)

art_transmission_reduction.notes: Reduction in transmission probability when on ART (96% = U=U)

art_mortality_reduction.notes: Reduction in HIV mortality when on ART (90% reduction)

art.notes: Time-based ART availability and uptake rates. Before first year: ART unavailable (rate=0). Between years: use stepwise (carry-forward) or linear interpolation based on interpolation setting.

interpolation.notes: 'stepwise' (carry forward last value) or 'linear' (interpolate between years)

initiation.notes: Annual probability of ART initiation for diagnosed individuals not on treatment

enabled.notes: Whether this intervention is active in the simulation

uptake_rate.notes: Annual probability of starting PrEP (susceptible only)

efficacy.notes: Protection per dosing cycle (86% effectiveness with adherence)

uptake_modifier_by_activity.notes: Multiplier for uptake rate by activity level

enabled.notes: Whether this intervention is active in the simulation

efficacy.notes: Protection per dosing cycle (99% from PURPOSE trials)

uptake_modifier_by_activity.notes: Multiplier for uptake rate by activity level
